name: Kodou Charging
description: Kodou Charging is a calm, single-column WordPress theme designed for commercial EV charging installers and workplace facilities. It pairs documentary site photography with structured assessment workflows, clear service pricing tables, and accessible tabbed site qualification. Built with clean typography and dependable notice banners to communicate technical competency without marketing excess.
